records.subject: STATUS OF DANKUNI–SURAT DEDICATED FREIGHT CORRIDOR
records.extent:
(a) to (c): it was inter-alia state that A new Dedicated Freight Corridor connecting Dankuni in East to Surat in West has been announced in 
the Union Budget 2026. The work of preparation/ updation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for this 
corridor has been taken up. The total cost of the project, funding mechanism, timelines etc. can be 
ascertained once DPR is finalized.

records.subject: EXPANSION AND MODERNISATION OF IISCO STEEL PLANT, BURNPUR
records.extent:
(a)to(c):   Steel Authority of India Limited approved the expansion of IISCO Steel Plant 
(ISP), Burnpur to 4.08 MTPA crude steel capacity on 08.01.2024 with an implementation 
schedule of 42 months.

records.subject: SMART METER INSTALLATION PROGRESS IN WEST BENGAL
records.extent:
(a) to (c) :  
Under Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), West Bengal has awarded 
contracts for 40,35,262 smart meters in the initial phase against sanctioned 2,10,35,262 smart meters. 
Progress as on 30.06.2026. please see the details in assurance part of the reply.During the Union Power Minister’s visit to West Bengal in May 2026, the State committed to 
complete the installation of all currently awarded smart meters by November 2027.
